title: a user native module this build cannot load, diagnosed rather than loaded silently

native_module.name: kr_wrong_abi
native_module.note: A module built against another Zsh ABI cannot be produced from a fixture, so what this case ships is a module file this build's loader refuses. What it proves is the diagnosis: the shell names the module it would not load, the module is absent from the loaded list, and the integration is still qualified afterwards.
